text.p: Micro-ASI International Inc said it terminated a corporate reorganization between it and Texas-based Micro-ASI Inc, because of Micro-ASI's failure to raise additional equity capital required by the reorganization agreement.
All common shares issued to Micro-ASI shareholders have been canceled, the company said, and it now had 577,770 common shares outstanding.
Micro-ASI International was formerly known as Symphony Ventures Inc. The company was not immediately available to comment further.
The company later said it had planned to acquire privately-held Micro-ASI Inc in a stock swap, but would not because of the additional equity captial requirements.

People nominated to Micro-ASI International's board of directors by Micro-ASI have resigned their positions, and Mark Schneider and David Chambers, former officers and directors of the company, have been reappointed to their former posts.
Micro-ASI International sid it was in substantially the same business and financial condition it was in before the reorganization effort.
It said it would resume its search for business opportunities and retain its name and stock symbol.
